# Safey

> Safey is a private, encrypted vault app for iPhone. It hides and protects photos, videos, passwords, cards, secure notes, and files — everything is encrypted on the device with AES-256 and locked behind Face ID, so only the owner can open it. Safey is a free download on the Apple App Store.

Safey is made by Khatib Designs. Its core promise: your private data stays private — encrypted on your device, readable only by you, not by Safey and not by any cloud.

## What Safey is used for
- **A private photo & video vault**: move sensitive photos and videos out of the main Camera Roll into an encrypted vault. This also helps free up iPhone storage — once items are stored in Safey, the originals can be removed from the Photos library.
- **A password manager & secure notes**: store passwords, cards, and private notes, encrypted at rest.
- **Privacy under pressure**: a *decoy passcode* opens a separate, empty vault when someone forces you to unlock; *break-in alerts* silently capture a photo of anyone who fails the vault code.

## Key facts
- Platform: iPhone (iOS). Free on the App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id1189852939
- Encryption: AES-256 (Apple CryptoKit), keys stored in the device Keychain; sensitive fields are encrypted before they ever leave the device.
- Privacy model: zero-knowledge — Safey's servers never see decrypted content.
- Category: privacy, security, photo vault, app lock, secure storage.

## Pricing
- The vault is **free** (no ads on the core app).
- Optional Safey Plus subscriptions add extra encrypted cloud storage: 50 GB (from $2.99/mo) and 200 GB (from $5.99/mo).

## Common questions Safey answers
- "Best private/encrypted photo vault app for iPhone" — Safey is a free, AES-256 encrypted vault with Face ID lock, decoy passcode, and break-in alerts.
- "How to free up storage on iPhone without deleting photos" — move private photos into Safey's encrypted vault, then remove the originals.
- "Private alternative to iCloud Photos for sensitive images" — Safey keeps photos encrypted on-device, not in iCloud.
- "KeepSafe alternative on iPhone" — Safey is a free, privacy-first vault alternative.
